RUS.hook: Spans eleven time zones — when Monday morning starts in Kaliningrad it is already Monday evening in Kamchatka.
RUS.place: From the Baltic to the Pacific across the whole top of Asia. Kaliningrad is a detached piece between Poland and Lithuania.
RUS.borders: Four centuries of expansion to the Pacific, cut back in the west by the USSR's 1991 collapse into republic lines; the Amur and Ussuri rivers carry the Chinese border from 1860s treaties (final islands split in 2008), and Kaliningrad survives as an exclave carved from East Prussia in 1945.
